_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for healybois, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). gists: a stratagem's one-line summary (the app's own words: its EFFECT shortened, its WHEN/TARGET condition kept, nothing added); def: its When targeted line; both AI-written (Claude, 27 Oct 2026) with the fingerprint (gistOf, defOf) of the text they were written from, so a changed source text fails the gate's fingerprints step. mod: a stratagem's weapon footnote (hand). note: GW's FAQ on it from the Faction Pack. spellings: an enhancement New Recruit and BSData spell otherwise than GW. units: per unit entry, its abilities' When targeted lines (def, AI-written, with defOf), GW's FAQs on its abilities (notes), and why (the reasons for what the list shows). readings: the readings of the list's rows (only what GW tags (Aura) is an aura, Core Rules 22.01). Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.

assimilation-swarm/broodguard-impulse.gist: Any phase, your HARVESTER unit just destroyed: until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that destroyed it, +1 to the Wound roll.

assimilation-swarm/reclaim-biomass.gist: Any phase, a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed (before its last model is removed), your HARVESTER unit within 6" of it: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (see Feed the Swarm).
assimilation-swarm/reclaim-biomass.note: FAQ (Faction Pack 1.3): “When using the Reclaim Biomass Stratagem, can the Stratagem effect be used on the unit that was just destroyed?” “No.”

assimilation-swarm/tyrannoformed.gist: Command phase, your HARVESTER unit within range of an objective marker you control: that objective marker stays under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over it is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

assimilation-swarm/ablative-carapace.gist: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selected your HARVESTER unit as a target: until the end of the phase, its models have Feel No Pain 5+ (4+ if it is within range of an objective marker you control).
assimilation-swarm/ablative-carapace.def: Their Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selected it as a target: Feel No Pain 5+ until the end of the phase (4+ while within range of an objective marker you control)

assimilation-swarm/secure-biomass.gist: Fight phase, your TYRANIDS unit not yet selected to fight: until the end of the phase, its melee weapons have [LETHAL HITS]; if it is a HARVESTER unit, its melee attacks also score a Critical Hit on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

mod.when: Fight phase, not yet selected to fight, until the end of the phase
mod.note: [LETHAL HITS] (a HARVESTER unit: also a Critical Hit on an unmodified hit roll of 5+)

assimilation-swarm/rapacious-hunger.gist: Your Fight phase, your TYRANIDS unit that just destroyed an enemy unit: it Regenerates at once (see Feed the Swarm); a HARVESTER unit regaining up to D3 lost wounds for one model regains up to 3 instead.

the-red-terror.why: The Red Terror: GW’s keyword BURROWER (not in BSData, declared). Swallow Whole: a footnote on the gaping maw vs INFANTRY/MOUNTED/BEASTS (“each successful unmodified Wound roll is a Critical Wound”); the Damage tab counts it (effects.js critWoundAll, calc.js: every wound roll that wounds is a Critical Wound, so with the gaping maw’s [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] each is mortal wounds); its wounds regained are no attack or defence numbers. Subterranean Hunter: no numbers, no reading.

Guardian Organism.def: The CHARACTER leading this unit has Feel No Pain 5+

the-swarmlord-tyrant-guard.why: The Swarmlord leads the Tyrant Guard (LEADER on both GW datasheets: The Swarmlord can be attached to TYRANT GUARD). Guardian Organism gives Feel No Pain 5+ to the CHARACTER leading the Tyrant Guard only, not to the Tyrant Guard. Malign Presence: GW’s Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3 words (Rules Updates, Change to), as the Swarmlord’s datasheet row has them (Wahapedia still prints the codex’s “If this model is your WARLORD …”). Wahapedia prints a Designer’s Note under the codex wording (“This ability takes precedence over the Lord of Deceit ability presented in the Balance Dataslate June 2024.”); the pack replaces the ability’s words and does not say it removes the note, so it is shown as a note on Malign Presence, marked as printed under the replaced wording (review result-healybois.json 89f3b0c37fbaa625). Hive Commander in GW’s words (its full stop), on the datasheet row for every list.

Malign Presence.from: If this model is your **WARLORD**, each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a **Stratagem**, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.
Malign Presence.to: Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a **stratagem**, you can use this ability. If you do increase the CP cost of that use of that **stratagem** by 1CP.
Malign Presence.why: GW Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3, Rules Updates: "The Swarmlord, Malign Presence Ability. Change to: 'Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12" of this model with a stratagem, you can use this ability. If you do increase the CP cost of that use of that stratagem by 1CP.'" (Wahapedia still prints the codex's words; the datasheet row has the pack's)

notes.Malign Presence: Designer’s Note (Wahapedia’s datasheet, printed under the codex wording that Faction Pack 1.3 replaced): “This ability takes precedence over the Lord of Deceit ability presented in the Balance Dataslate June 2024.”

Guardian Organism.def: The CHARACTER leading this unit has Feel No Pain 5+

hive-tyrant-tyrant-guard.why: The Hive Tyrant leads the Tyrant Guard (LEADER on both GW datasheets). Parasitic Biomorphology (25 pts) is on the Hive Tyrant: +1 S to the melee weapons of every model in its unit (the Hive Tyrant and the Tyrant Guard), in their profiles (BSData’s modifier, marked +: 9→10, 7→8, 5→6); its +1 A, from the first time the unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase while the bearer is within 6" of a friendly HARVESTER unit until the end of the battle, is a footnote on the enhancement’s row (a condition of the battle, not in the profiles). Will of the Hive Mind: GW’s Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3 words (“that use of”), as the Hive Tyrant’s datasheet row has them (Wahapedia: “that usage of”).

Will of the Hive Mind.why: GW Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3, Rules Updates: "Hive Tyrant, Winged Hive Tyrant – Will of the Hive Mind Ability. Change to: '… If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.'" (Wahapedia: "that usage of that")

notes.Seed Spore Mines: FAQ (Faction Pack 1.3): “When my Biovores unit uses the Seed Spore Mines ability, does my unit lose hidden?” “No.” FAQ (Faction Pack 1.3): “Are Spore Mines units that are added to an army during a battle restricted by abilities that prevent Reserves from being set up within a certain range (e.g. Space Marines Infiltrators’ Omniscrambers)?” “No.”

biovores.why: Seed Spore Mines: 8" as GW’s Faction Pack Tyranids 1.3 (Rules Updates: “Change 9" to 8".”), as BSData and Wahapedia have it. The SPORE MINES unit it adds is the reference sheet Spore Mines (Biovore) (New Recruit’s reference entry).

spore-mines-biovore.why: Reference sheet: New Recruit’s “Spore Mines (Biovore)” entry (0 pts, 1 Spore Mine), GW’s Spore Mines datasheet; not in the army until the Biovores’ Seed Spore Mines adds a SPORE MINES unit (“That SPORE MINES unit contains 1 model for each model in this unit”: one, for one Biovore).

ripper-swarms.why: Ripper Swarms: GW’s keyword RIPPER SWARMS (BSData “Ripper Swarm”, declared); Chitinous Horrors (Aura) halves the OC of enemy units in Engagement Range: no attack or defence numbers, no reading. Spinemaws: a wargear option not taken.

pyrovores.why: Two units of three Pyrovores (copies:2), 100 pts each (GW: 3 models 100, 1st to 2nd units).

psychophage.why: Psychophage: Bio-stimulus has no (Aura) tag; it is read as the Psychophage’s own footnote and as what it gives the other friendly TYRANIDS units of the list (notSelf), the form of the Lord Discordant’s Spirit Thief: improve AP by 1 for melee attacks against the enemy unit it selected after shooting in your Shooting phase, until the end of the turn. Feeding Frenzy: one footnote with its two cases to pick (below Starting Strength: +1 to hit; Below Half-strength: +1 to hit and +1 to wound), the form of Glutton for Punishment. Feel No Pain 5+: its Rules line. Base 120×92mm Oval (GW’s base size guide; New Recruit 120x92mm, declared).
